trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR (reported, not fixed): (1) q-COLLISION IN THE TORUS-KNOT INDEX. The block writes T_{p,q} throughout, so q is the second torus index while q is simultaneously the substrate parameter of H_n(R,q) everywhere else in the chapter. Proposed: T_{p,r} or T_{p,s}. Same defect class as the flavor index in def:flavor-dressing-functor. (2) H_2 IS AMBIGUOUS: Empirical evaluation on H_2 bound states reads as the Hecke algebra H_2 in this chapter, but the partitions given are of 4 (2+1+1 and 3+1), so H_2 must mean the hydrogen MOLECULE (2 protons + 2 electrons = 4 constituents). AGENTS.md SS7aa already forbids bare H_q for exactly this reason; say which. (3) INTERNAL CONSISTENCY VERIFIED: lambda = (p,1^{n-p}) has |lambda| = n; T_{2,9} -> (2,1,1) and T_{3,5} -> (3,1) are both the n = 4 instance, and gcd(2,9) = gcd(3,5) = 1 so both torus links are knots with a p-cycle permutation, as the embedding argument requires. (4) THE INFERENCE IS NOT ESTABLISHED: that a p-cycle orbit FORCES the Wedderburn weight onto (p,1^{n-p}) is asserted, not derived - orbit size does not by itself determine which Wedderburn block carries the dominant weight.
